name: Commerce Imoje
description: Commerce integration for the imoje payment gateway (ING, Poland). Adds two Drupal Commerce payment gateway plugins — imoje (off-site paywall redirect) and imoje Blik (on-site BLIK code entry via AJAX) — with admin-issued refunds. Orders are confirmed by imoje's asynchronous IPN, whose X-Imoje-Signature is verified against the configured service key before a payment is recorded.
project_description:
This Drupal module integrates imoje payment services with Drupal Commerce, offering a seamless payment solution. It's designed for users looking for an efficient and secure way to incorporate imoje payment methods into their Drupal-based e-commerce platforms. This module simplifies transactions, enhancing the shopping experience for customers and site administrators alike.

 Features 
 
 Two New Payment Methods: Provides imoje (Off-site redirect) and imoje Blik (On-site blik transaction) as additional payment options. 
 Payment refunds straight from Drupal interface. 
 User-Friendly Integration: Easy to configure within Drupal's Commerce payment and checkout systems. 

 
 Post-Installation 
 Upon installation, administrators can add the imoje payment gateways via the "admin/commerce/config/payment-gateways/add" path. Essential credentials and notification addresses must be configured in the imoje panel to ensure proper functionality. The module provides a straightforward, guided setup process.

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires the Drupal Commerce2 module.
